steps.note: Open the Purchase Requisitions area on the buyer side.
Ensure the PR list is on the Open tab where eligible material lines can be found.

args.goal: Find an Open purchase requisition containing a material line, open the PR number, open that line's Details view, and stop with the details showing Item Type, Material / Service code, Account Assignment Category, quantity, and unit.

steps.note: The catalog has no dedicated step for opening a PR number and its line Details view, so perform that buyer-side navigation on screen.
Check that the details identify the line as material.
Confirm the item type field is displayed.
Confirm the material or service code field is displayed.
Confirm the account assignment field is displayed.
Confirm the quantity field is displayed.
Confirm the unit field is displayed.
